info.title: Melted development API
info.description: Implemented development subset of protocol v1: identity, reading, trusted collector plugins and raw ingestion; optional explicit preference compilation, classification/tagging, filtering and source-faithful text generation after confirmation. Server-controlled operator/BYOK/admin-shared credential modes use a finite write-only settings DSL. Public general ingest, multimodal processing, external corroboration, learning and full snapshot sync remain unimplemented. List bodies/evidence are empty; fetch detail. Times are UTC RFC3339. Search is literal substring.
